'''Savorin Malfus the Seventh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] noble of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Malfus acquired information as to the whereabouts of [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Corwin]], and when a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] in the employ of [[House Girard]] came to collect the information, Malfus demanded that the hunter carry out a series of errands for him. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] refused and, after [[Death/Legends|killing]] Malfus's bodyguards, severely beat Malfus and took the information.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
Malfus was a very arrogant man. Spoiled and entitled, he treated anyone who was not a noble as though they were dirt. He would not even let them within ten paces of him. He looked down on the Hunter and viewed them as less than a servant.

==Behind the scenes==
Savorin Malfus the Seventh appears as a character in the Bounty Hunter mission "Spiking the Punch" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He asks players to deliver gifts to [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] [[Dugan Cortess]], [[Paulus Thul]], and [[Norn Girard]]. Players can choose to do Malfus's errands for light side alignment points, but as the Bounty Hunter is an Imperial class and thus assumed to make the dark side choices, this article assumes that the hunter refused and beat up Malfus.<ref name="TOR" />
